references.text: Pagiel son of Ocran is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Asher at the census.
Pagiel son of Ocran is named as the leader of the tribe of Asher in the camp arrangement.
Pagiel son of Ocran brought his offering on the eleventh day during the dedication of the altar.
The tribe of Asher descends from Jacob's son Asher, born to Zilpah.
Jacob's blessing over Asher, who became the ancestor of the tribe of Asher.
